title: J. Cole Shocked After Bra Is Thrown Onstage During ‘Work Out’ Performance: ‘Gotta Cherish That Sh–‘
summary: The North Carolina rapper laughed and held the bra up to the crowd during a tour stop in Miami.
contentText:
J. Cole ‘s  The Fall-Off World Tour has gotten off to an auspicious start.

Last week during the tour’s second stop in Miami, a couple got engaged as he was performing “Life Sentence,” one of the latest cuts from his most recent album The Fall-Off , which is dedicated to love and marriage despite the song’s title. “What’s up, baby girl? What’s up, my boy? God bless y’all,” the rapper said once he caught wind of their engagement. “That’s f—ing beautiful. Y’all make some noise for them, man.”

There was also another couple who were getting married the day after the show at Miami’s Kaseya Center and had their seats upgraded by Cole’s team and invited him and his manager Ibrahim Hamad to the wedding. “Aye @KingOfQueenz @JColeNC we just wanna say thank you for tonight’s show in Miami. our original tickets had an ‘obstructed view’ and so y’all upgraded our tickets to the front row,” the fan  wrote on X . “Y’all let a bunch of fans since 2010 make a core memory. thank you. my lady and I get married tomorrow at 3pm in Miami if y’all would like to come. shoutout to Cole for showing us love during Life Sentence.”

And now, during the tour’s fourth stop at Atlanta’s State Farm Arena, someone threw their bra onstage as Cole was performing his hit record “Work Out” from his 2011 debut studio album Sideline Story . “N—a ain’t got a bra onstage in a long motherf—in’ time, boy,” he told the crowd as he was laughing in shock . “You gotta cherish that sh–.”

The American leg of Cole’s tour ends in his hometown of Fayetteville, North Carolina, at Crown Coliseum on Sept. 3. He then heads out for the European leg starting Oct. 7 at Uber Arena in Berlin and will end it at Unity Arena in Oslo, Norway, on Nov. 12, so there’s still plenty of time to catch him if you haven’t gotten the chance to already.

Make sure to bring either a bra or an engagement ring — or both.
